title: Dog Night, 2005 · before
logline: The night before six years: the gravel behind the Lanes and the dog walking it slower than last year, and Wood matching him, and the strip's panels getting a little wider each one to hold the slowness. The sign all lit.

panels.composition: The alley. WOOD and BARNABY walking, the dog slow.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man and a dog walking slowly down a night alley beneath a lit neon sign

panels.composition: A little wider: the dog stopping to sniff; Wood waiting.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a dog stopped to sniff gravel in a night alley while a man waits with a slack leash

panels.composition: Wider: the two of them small under the sign, still.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a man and a dog small and still beneath a fully lit neon bowling sign in a night alley

panels.composition: Widest: the alley empty at the far end, the two of them just entering it from the left, slow.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a long empty night alley with a man and a dog just entering at the left edge walking slowly

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The panels widen for the slowness.
